request_text: Fire extinguisher cabinet is locked and nobody has the key.
Half of my apartment has no power. Neighbours still have theirs and my breaker is not tripped.
The fire extinguisher was used last week and nobody replaced it. The cabinet is empty.
Hallway smoke alarm went off briefly while I was cooking and now it won't beep at all when I test it.
The lock on the garage side door sticks.
The porch step has rotted and my elderly father nearly fell through it.
Kitchen sink is backing up into the dishwasher and there is water on the floor.
Staff found a wasp nest on the outside window ledge.
An ice patch forms at the ramp entrance every morning.
Smoke alarm in the bedroom was beeping, and now it has gone silent. I think someone took the battery out.
The hallway light switch is hot to the touch.
Toilet is overflowing and water is spreading into the hallway.
A desk lamp sparked and smoked when plugged into the wall. The outlet is blackened.
The fire alarm keeps going off around 2 am every night. Residents are exhausted.
I am seeing bed bugs crawling on the sofa.
CO alarm shows error code E3 and will not reset.
Our suite door won't lock and we leave laptops in there overnight.
The front door frame needs a touch-up.
There is no smoke alarm in the corridor outside unit 41, only the empty base on the ceiling.
Boiler pressure gauge is reading very high and the relief valve is hissing.
No heat at all. The house is 14 degrees and my elderly mother is staying with us.
Our smoke alarm chirps every few minutes. We have a newborn at home.
Water drips from the ceiling light in the upstairs bathroom whenever it rains.
Spotted a few ants near the windowsill.
Door closer on the suite door slams shut.
A dead tree is leaning over the playground after the high winds.
The water fountain tastes of metal.
Air feels stuffy and warm in the meeting rooms.
Fire extinguisher gauge is in the red.
A ceiling tile in the boardroom is wet and sagging.
